description: Restructuring the Gem and Jewellery Research and Training Institute as the Research and Training Division of the National Gem and Jewellery Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Gem and Jewellery Authority has been established by the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act No. 50 of 1993. In accordance with the provisions of the said Act, the Gem and Jewellery Research and Training Institute was established in the year 1995 for research and training activities related to the gem and jewellery industry. Although the said two Institutions are providing parallel services for the development of the gem and jewellery industry, it has been observed that due to the lack of a unified methodology, there are inefficient resources utilization and inconsistent policies in the operation of the said institutions.  The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-03-17, has given approval in principle to amalgamate the said two Institutions, based on the recommendations submitted after studying this matter by the Officials’ Committee for the Review on State-Owned Non-Commercial Entities, chaired by the Secretary to the Prime Minister,  In accordance with the said approval, an Officials’ Committee has been appointed by the Secretary to the Ministry of Industries and Entrepreneurship Development to submit recommendations regarding the relevant structural reforms. The proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to establish the Gem and Jewellery Research and Training Institute as the Research and Training Division of the National Gem and Jewellery Authority and to take the relevant legal activities for this purpose as per the provisions of the National Gem and Jewellery Authority Act, No. 50 of 1993, based on the Report of the said Officials' Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.
